prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal vertical Y2K night-street flash portrait of an adult woman sitting comfortably on a broad sidewalk step. She wears a mustard-yellow beanie, an oversized blank navy sports jersey over a long-sleeve black top, loose indigo denim trousers, yellow high-top boots, and white socks. One elbow rests on her knee and the other hand holds a phone with an abstract unreadable screen; a plain mustard shoulder bag sits beside her. Set the scene on a nighttime urban block with warm arch lights and abstract storefronts without readable signage. Use high-contrast direct flash, ambient streetlight falloff, 35mm disposable-camera grain, a slightly tilted candid angle, natural skin, and no logos, numbers, text, or watermark.
